query: SELECT o.occurred_at, o.session_id FROM observations AS o JOIN namespaces AS n ON (n.tenant_id, n.id) = (o.tenant_id, o.namespace_id) WHERE o.tenant_id = $1 AND o.id = $2 AND o.namespace_id = ANY($3) AND o.access_level <= $4::smallint AND n.state = 'active' AND (o.expires_at IS NULL OR o.expires_at > now())
